Subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping — Acme Health

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

- Recap: high-level POC scope (pilot ingest + inference for clinical summarization), expected ~5k MAUs for pilot.
- Stakeholder ask: please confirm the economic buyer, security lead, and procurement contact so we can route materials.
- Security kickoff: we'll need a short list of systems in-scope (EHR, integrations, SSO/IdP, analytics/data lake). If you can share network diagrams or an architecture overview that helps speed the intake.
- Questionnaire: attached is our standard Security Pack (policies, SOC2 cover letter, encryption details). If you have a vendor security questionnaire, please send it back and we'll complete it.
- Next actions: 1) Daniel to confirm stakeholders and timeline; 2) Emily/Priya to confirm systems in scope and any specific compliance needs (PHI handling, BAAs); 3) Redwood to return completed items within 3 business days once we receive the questionnaire.

I'll also introduce our security lead (Rishi) to partner on technical Qs. Looking forward to next steps — can we tentatively target a kickoff call later this week?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Pack.zip (policies + SOC2 link stub)

Thanks Marissa — appreciated. Quick answers from my side:

- Economic buyer: Emily Stone (CIO) — she will own budget/contract.
- Security lead: Priya Desai (Priya is our security/compliance lead).
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com will own contract terms and PO.
- Technical review: Rajiv Khatri (DevOps lead) will own the architecture/operational review.

Systems in scope for the pilot we expect:
- Epic integration (FHIR endpoints)
- Staging analytics/data lake (S3 buckets behind VPC peering)
- Our identity provider (Okta) for SSO and service accounts

We do have a vendor security questionnaire — attaching our intake template will help (we'll send in follow up). Timeline: security questionnaire this week, procurement review next week (goal to finalize terms within 2 weeks). For documents we need from Redwood: SOC2 report, DPA/BAA details, and a filled questionnaire.

Happy to do a brief kickoff Thurs or Fri.

Best,

Acme Health

- Confirming scope: Epic (FHIR), staging analytics, Okta for SSO. Please flag any additional systems (e.g., file shares, EHR sync agents).
- Requested docs from our side: SOC2 report (link below), DPA/BAA template, encryption and infra diagrams. I've attached our Redwood_Security_Pack.zip that includes the SOC2 cover letter and a short infra FAQ. Full SOC2 is available via secure link: https://redwood.example.com/soc2-report.
- To speed intake: can you share the questionnaire as soon as possible (Daniel indicated you'll send it). Once we have it, Rishi (cc'd) will take primary on the detailed responses and can hop on a technical call with Rajiv.
- Tentative kickoff: proposing Fri 2026-08-13 10:00 PT — if that works we'll send a calendar invite and agenda (30m: introductions, systems in scope, data flows, timeline).

I'll prepare short answers to the commercial questions for Procurement — Sean (legal) can help on contractual items (DPA/BAA).

Thanks,
Marissa

Forwarding the thread from Acme — they confirmed stakeholders and will send the vendor questionnaire. Can you please:

1) Rishi: once we receive the questionnaire, can you own completing the technical sections (infra, encryption, access controls, logging)? They flagged Okta, Epic FHIR endpoints, and S3 staging buckets as in-scope. Expect ~20-30 Qs.
2) Sean: procurement will need a short DPA/BAA and SOC2 link. Can you prepare the standard DPA template and any notes on exceptions we typically accept?
3) If either of you want to join the kickoff call (Fri 8/13 10:00 PT), please let me know. I'll send calendar invites once Emily confirms.

Also flagging any redlines we should proactively consider (e.g., data residency, retention limits, indemnity caps) — I'll surface to Acme procurement.

Thanks — Marissa

Hi Marissa — thanks. Attached is our completed vendor questionnaire (Acme_Security_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx) and our risk register excerpt for the pilot. A few quick notes:

- We've prioritized the questionnaire sections we need answered for our initial review; please return responses by EOD Thu if possible so procurement can start contract review on Mon.

- Systems in scope confirmed. Rajiv will coordinate the technical call with Rishi as needed.
